name: tutorial-float
title: Tutorial Float
description: Floating card for hands-on tutorials. Follows an anchor every frame: beside it when there's room, otherwise over the top of what it covers, kept inside an optional boundary, and slid aside from a point it shouldn't hide. Step counter and dots, Skip, a done card with its own button that fades out and closes itself, a slow bob, and reduced motion respected. Pair it with Tutorial Actions.
